purpose: Exercise the validated V2.8.4 candidate-discovery, official-PDF, page-text and page-scoped classification chain on a small deterministic set of real CNInfo filings without creating production or prospective eligibility states.

scope.sample_selection: Sort all deduplicated candidates by SHA256(announcement_id) ascending and take the first 4.

pipeline: deduplicate and validate canonical security identity plus official adjunct_url
download only selected official PDFs from static.cninfo.com.cn
validate raw PDF bytes and bind object SHA256
extract embedded page text with 1-based physical page provenance
apply frozen sentence-level AI-Core rule engine page-by-page
aggregate filing decision with frozen page-scoped aggregation

failure_semantics.individual_pdf_fetch_or_text_failure: record per-filing blocker and continue other selected filings
